description: Runs a social publishing automation once, now: it posts publicly to its connected channels at once. Use when the user says publish now, post it now, or test-run an automation. Not for scheduling (use set_social_automation_state). Returns a confirmation; the outcome and post links show in list_social_automation_events. A successful post uses 1 social export from the monthly quota. Posts can't be unpublished from here.

automation_id.description: ID of the publishing automation. Get it from list_social_automations.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: run_social_automation_now
title: Publish now
